asr.temperature: 0.0 with fallback through 1.0; default compression-ratio and log-prob gates

environment.snr_definition: active-speech RMS / noise RMS, measured per clip before the 8 kHz mu-law roundtrip

fixtures.source: Microsoft Edge TTS, synthetic Tamil/Tanglish scripts

policy.definition: Both raw and conditioned decodes are parsed. The sheet is pre-filled when both validate to the same four values, or when exactly one validates; otherwise the turn goes to readback or re-ask.

claim: On 24 synthetic Tamil/Tanglish clips a single spectral front-end did not consistently fix noise (band+gate vs none: 11/24 vs 12/24 exact at 5 dB, 16/24 vs 22/24 clean), so the shipped line listens twice: it pre-filled 22/24 clean pours correctly with 0 silent errors, 12/24 at 5 dB with 0 silent errors (raw alone: 12 correct, 2 silent errors), and 6/24 at 0 dB with 1 silent error (raw: 7, 2 silent errors); everything else went to readback or re-ask (our own synthetic clips, not field data; n=24 per cell, Wilson 95% CIs in the table).
caveats: 24 synthetic clips per condition; each cell has n=24, not independent samples.
All voices are TTS, not real farmers; no field audio was collected.
The slot compiler's variant lexicon was developed while inspecting ASR output from this fixture set.
Recorded before the participant supplied a Gnani key; the run uses faster-whisper medium · float16 · CUDA. A separate live-provider check over the same matrix is reported in the Evidence tab.
SNR is measured on active speech and set before the 8 kHz mu-law roundtrip.
The two-path gate is scored from the same raw and conditioned runs; it adds no third decode.
The single-pass conditioned arm is reported even though it is not the shipped path.
